name: choosing never erases (M286): three options enumerated become option children; picking one marks it chosen and the others dropped, every statement intact

seed.content: Which floor to lay in the kitchen

rounds.user: Three floor options: (1) engineered oak, warm but marks easily; (2) porcelain tile, hard-wearing but cold underfoot; (3) polished concrete, cheapest but needs sealing every two years.
rounds.assistant: Oak (warm, marks), porcelain tile (hard-wearing, cold), polished concrete (cheapest, sealing every two years).

rounds.user: Let's go with the porcelain tile.
